office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the Asotin County Superior Court, keeping its case records, dockets and filings.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Clerk McKenzie A. Campbell, in office since 2016, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Asotin County Clerk since 2016, previously the office's chief deputy, running unopposed for another term.
highlights: Clerk since her August 2016 appointment; chief deputy clerk 2012-2016 [S1]
Digitizing and archiving older court records [S1]
